method: Full analysis: every FR/NFR/SC located in src/** with file:line; every N-variant/N-field claim recounted; IDispatcher contracts touched by the branch checked against both implementors (dispatcher, dispatcher-p2p). cargo not permitted in this session, so SC-2/3/4/7 not re-executed.

branch_inputs_verified.code_location: components/dispatcher/src/lib.rs:1214-1221 (not counted in evict_and_insert), :3507 and :3541 (counted in reserve_memory only)

branch_inputs_verified.status: aligned for dispatcher; violated by dispatcher-p2p (see FR-008(c))

drifted.spec_text: spec.md:185 `clear_memory_tier(&self) -> Result<usize, DispatcherError>` - Evict all memory-tier entries. | src/idispatcher.rs:808-809 doc: 'Entries still being written are removed entirely.'
drifted.actual: A pinned entry (incl. the write-through pin) keeps its slot and is retried; Timeout after 5 s with pinned entries left resident; Ok(n) counts only entries really cleared (commit cccfb328e, dispatcher FR-038).

drifted.spec_text: spec.md:186 `flush_to_ssd(&self) -> Result<usize, DispatcherError>` - Flush pending writes to SSD.
drifted.actual: Returns IoError if a failed write-through left an entry resident with no SSD copy; else the number of memory-tier entries that are is_evictable (commit 9bd231d85). Interface doc already updated (approved).

drifted.spec_text: src/idispatcher.rs:627-628 remove 'Does NOT block waiting for background write-through ... Proceeds immediately'; :832-837 flush_to_ssd IoError on failed write-through; :806-810 clear_memory_tier.
drifted.actual: dispatcher-p2p flush_to_ssd returns pre-flush in_flight() and never IoError; clear_memory_tier frees the slot of an ActiveReferences entry and counts it; remove maps the write-through pin's ActiveReferences to KeyNotFound. These are the three pre-repair bugs fixed in dispatcher by 9bd231d85 / cccfb328e / 0236a3c98.

drifted.actual: 22 methods; batch_populate (:688) and tier_event_stats (:883) unlisted; copy_gpu_to_memory_async takes `regions: &[IpcHandle]` (:732).

12 fields; adds caller_wait (default None) and connection_teardown_timeout (default 1000 ms).
